title: Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None Bitdeer mined 281.1 BTC last week and sold all of it, leaving the miner with no bitcoin of its own as of Nov. 20 while American Bitcoin borrows against its reserve instead. This post Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
